item.title: Get Lectured: SCI-Arc, Spring '26
item.description: Get Lectured takes a look at upcoming public lectures and events happening at the Downtown LA campus of SCI-Arc, an Archinect Partner School, this semester. item.title: Hidden Forest Residence by WSAA Design Team
item.description: Hidden Forest Residence holds two interwoven meanings. One speaks to the woodland habitat—Shulin, the forest itself. The other is a gentle phonetic echo of “neighbor,” suggesting that we are not masters of nature, but temporary lodgers in the home of our living surroundings. This project begins with a simple stance: architecture does not possess the land; it borrows it. item.title: New Sphere venue could be coming to the Washington D.C. area
item.description: A consortium has announced plans to pursue the development of a new Sphere venue at National Harbor, Maryland. If completed, the project would become the second Sphere location in the United States and the first to employ a smaller-scale version of the venue’s design. item.title: Toronto's 2026 Winter Stations installations bring 'Mirage' flair to its beachfront
item.description: Toronto’s annual Winter Stations competition is back with another round of public art installations to activate its urban beaches during the coldest season. This year's "Mirage" theme had participants design structures responsive to the "boundary of what is seen and what is real in the age of AI and explore public art as infrastructure that gathers people in shared reality." item.title: Design proposals for Trump's Dulles International Airport overhaul include Zaha Hadid Architects, Adjaye Associates, Grimshaw
item.description: Competing design proposals have been unveiled for a new terminal at Washington Dulles International Airport. Last month, President Trump called for a rebuilding of the airport, reportedly calling the existing Eero Saarinen facilities “terrible” and “incorrectly designed.” Proposal by Zaha Hadid Architects and Bermello Ajamil & Partners. Image courtesy of the Department of TransportationSeveral major design studios have now responded to a call from the Department of Transportation for proposals.

item.title: Bridging Architecture, Interiors, and Furniture Design With ALA Studio
item.description: Archinect's latest Studio Snapshot features New York-based architecture and interior design practice ALA Studio. item.title: JURASSIC in Chengdu by SAKO Architects
item.description: The children’s floor of a shopping mall in Chengdu has been designed as a public area with multiple shops under the theme “The Jurassic World Where Dinosaurs Thrived.” This concept celebrates the grandeur and scale of the Jurassic era—when everything was larger than life—through recurring motifs of dinosaur teeth, eggs, spots, and the stems of climbing plants.
